paragraphs: I'm a full stack developer that learned everything on my own. I specialize in creating dynamic, scalable web applications from front-end to back-end. I build responsive user interfaces and robust server-side solutions that work seamlessly across all devices.

I am proficient in React, Next.js, Node.js, Express.js, JavaScript, TypeScript, HTML5, CSS, and Tailwind CSS. My expertise includes Git version control, MongoDB, PostgreSQL, MySQL databases, and deployment on Vercel and Netlify platforms.

I'm passionate about writing clean, maintainable code and staying current with emerging technologies. Whether it's building RESTful APIs, implementing authentication systems, or optimizing database performance, I deliver comprehensive solutions that exceed expectations.
